notes_for_us: A map rotation has no container shape. The rules say the top-level shape must be either the dominant segment or the thing that contains them, and five sibling competitive maps are neither — so the top level had to be one of them chosen by list order, which is exactly the 'wrong shape above a list of separate maps' failure the rules warn about, with no correct alternative available.

Enriched added weapon pickup points to every map, which the prompt positively excludes — you get your next weapon from an elimination, not from the floor. Worth noting because collectible-loot is the obvious Shooter option and taking it would have contradicted the design.
The five maps each want their own theme and the segment theme field handled that well. It is the first field in this batch that fitted a prompt better than the top-level equivalent would have.
A prompt this long is almost entirely mechanics, and step 0's triage handled it without strain — only about a tenth of the words were layout.
